title: Colonial Viper Mk II (Battlestar Galactica, 2004)
intro: The Viper is a fictional single-pilot fighter launched from battlestars in the series Battlestar Galactica (2004). The series flies the old Mk II alongside the newer, networked Mk VII. The pilot sits under a bubble canopy with a centre stick, a throttle for the left hand and an old-style panel of dials around the DRADIS scope.

areas.name: Canopy
areas.text: The bubble canopy over the seat.

panels.name: Canopy
panels.text: The clear bubble over the Viper pilot's seat.
panels.context: It gives a good view for dogfights against Cylon fighters.

controls.name: Canopy
controls.text: A clear bubble over the single seat of the Viper Mk II.
controls.context: The pilot looks out through it to find enemy fighters.

areas.name: DRADIS display
areas.text: The radar-like scope in front of the pilot.

panels.name: DRADIS display
panels.text: A round radar-like screen that shows other ships around the Viper.
panels.context: DRADIS is the series' word for radar; the pilot watches it to see where friends and Cylons are.

controls.name: DRADIS scope
controls.text: This round screen shows contacts, other ships, around the fighter.
controls.context: It warns the pilot of ships that are not yet visible through the canopy.

controls.name: Contact markers
controls.text: Marks on the scope show which contacts are friends and which are Cylons.
controls.context: The pilot uses them to pick a target and avoid shooting a friend.

areas.name: Analog instrument panel
areas.text: Old-style dials and switches of the old design.

panels.name: Analog instrument panel
panels.text: Old-style round dials, arming switches and warning lights.
panels.context: The old Mk II has no networked computers; in the series this makes it safe from the Cylons' computer attacks.

controls.name: Flight gauges
controls.text: Round dials show the speed, the fuel and the engines.
controls.context: The pilot checks them during the flight, like the dials of an old car.

controls.name: Weapons arming switches
controls.text: Switches that make the guns ready to fire ('hot') before an attack.
controls.context: Until the guns are armed, the trigger does nothing; it is a safety step.

controls.name: Warning lights
controls.text: Lights that warn the pilot of damage and low fuel.
controls.context: They tell the pilot when to head back to the battlestar.

panels.name: Side consoles
panels.text: The radio and the thruster controls beside the seat.
panels.context: They let the pilot talk to the battlestar and turn the Viper with small thrusters.

controls.name: Comms
controls.text: The radio (wireless) link to the battlestar and to the other pilots of the wing.
controls.context: Pilots get their orders and call for help over it.

controls.name: Thruster controls
controls.text: Small reaction thrusters let the pilot spin the Viper around in space, for example to fire backwards while flying forwards.
controls.context: In the series a pilot uses this trick to flip the Viper and shoot at chasers.

areas.name: Stick and throttle
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Flight stick
panels.text: The centre stick in front of the pilot, held in the right hand.
panels.context: It steers the Viper and fires the guns.

controls.name: Flight stick
controls.text: Pushing the stick forward or pulling it back tips the nose down or up; moving it left or right rolls the fighter.
controls.context: It is a classic fighter stick in the right hand.

controls.name: Gun trigger
controls.text: Pulling the trigger on the front of the stick fires the guns.
controls.context: The guns have to be armed with the switches on the panel first.

panels.name: Throttle
panels.text: The throttle lever at the pilot's left hand.
panels.context: It sets the power of the main engines.

controls.name: Throttle
controls.text: Pushing the throttle forward gives the main engines more power; pulling it back gives less.
controls.context: The pilot sets the speed with the left hand while the right hand steers.
